experiment: R4 on E5: selection-refit outer bootstrap, symmetric table, L2 incremental value
scope: exploratory, internally cross-validated date-policy selection study; random held-out weekly quizzes of an already-inspected dataset, not prospective or independent temporal validation; compares a two-policy class with a date-conditioned class (L1), does not isolate L2/L3 except in the secondary masking contrasts

outer_bootstrap.fold_unit: distinct original quiz: all copies of a resampled quiz share one fold; distinct quizzes ordered by default_rng keys drawn after the resampling indices and cut into 5 contiguous near-equal groups (E.folds_for size rule)
outer_bootstrap.selection_in_draw: quiz-weighted dev mean over quiz copies (multiplicity-weighted); exact ties to the earliest candidate: float ranking, structural ties detected from exact per-quiz equality, remaining near-ties (<1e-6) re-evaluated with Fractions
outer_bootstrap.statistic: cross-fitted audit - naive difference in the resampled data set, quiz-weighted and question-pooled
outer_bootstrap.multiplicity: Holm across 9 generators on the quiz-weighted refit p

design.verdict_rule: unchanged actions if audit and naive held-out actions identical in all 100 stored fits; else significant gain/loss if Holm p < 0.05 (sign of the stored 20-repeat estimate); else unresolved

reference_check.note: explicit pseudo-quiz expansion with exact Fraction selection reproduces every score column of the vectorised engine on these draws

heldout_action_disagreement.note: held-out (question, repeat) instances where the audit and naive choices differ in whether retrieval is used; 0 means the selections differ at most in label

leakage_variant_naive.note: cross-fitted F1 of the naive procedure run on masked vs unmasked RAG outputs; unmasked outputs may use post-question evidence, so this is not a deployable utility contrast

stored.verdict_e5_wording: decision unchanged (identical selections in every fit)
